bagPolicy.summary: Frost Bank Center allows bags 12" x 12" x 6" or smaller, with magnetometer screening at entry. Bag policies may vary by event.
prohibited: Drawstring bags that exceed size limits
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are allowed and will be screened and tagged by Security.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Frost Bank Center can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: For drop-off, use any open parking lot entrance. For pickup, exit through the arena doors closest to Section 125 and meet your driver in the designated Passenger & Rideshare Pick-up Zone in Pink Lot.

concessions.note: Frost Bank Center offers a variety of food and drink options, including casual dining at The Agave Club and upscale public concessions at the Frost Club. Highlights include creative shareable appetizers at the ULTRA Club, brisket tacos at Davila's BBQ, and smashburgers at Roadhouse. The venue is cashless and features a wide selection of beverages, including premium cocktails and souvenir draft beers.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Service animals are welcome and must stay on a leash or in a harness. A Sensory Room is on the Balcony Level in Section 230; ask Guest Services at Section 101 or 207 for access. Private restrooms are available on every level for guests who need help from a companion.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted at Frost Bank Center.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office opens 3 hours prior to the event start time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For most events, doors open one hour before the scheduled start time, but door times vary. Check your event page or call the Fan Experience Team at 210-444-5140.
